subject: general
question: How many members are there in the Security Council of the UN as of October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5 permanent members and 10 non-permanent members**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **United Nations Security Council **is **one **of the **UN's most important bodies.**
 
• It is in **charge **of **maintaining international peace **and **security **in the **first place**.
 
• **5 permanent **members and **10 non-permanent **members are in the **Security Council **of the **UN as of October 2020**.
 
• **India **has been **elected **as **a non-permanent member **of the **UN Security Council 8 times till Oct 2020**.
 
• **India **has been **elected as **a **non-permanent member **of the Council for **the years 1950-1951**, **1967-1968**, **1972-1973**, **1977-1978**, **1984-1985**, **1991-1992**, **2011-2012**, and **2021-2022**.
 
• India **assumed **the **presidency **of the **United Nations Security Council (UNSC) **for **one month in August 2021**.
 
• The **next month **of **India's presidency **of the **Council **will be **December 2022**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **United Nations Security Council **met for the **first time in church House in Westminster, London, **in **January 17, 1946**.
 
• The **Security **Council has had **a permanent home **at the **United Nations Headquarters **in **New York City **since its **first meeting.**
 
• **Permanent members**:
 
 
• China.
 
• France.
 
• Russia.
 
• The United Kingdom.
 
• The United States.
 
 
 
• **Non-permanent members**:
 
 
• Estonia.
 
• India.
 
• Ireland.
 
• Kenya.
 
• Mexico.
 
• Niger.
 
• Norway.
 
• Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.
 
• Tunisia.
 
• Vietnam.
